allow: PowerShell($c = Get-Content "docs/prompt.md" -Raw; "Lines: " + \(Get-Content "docs/prompt.md" | Measure-Object -Line\).Lines; "Size KB: " + [math]::Round\($c.Length/1KB,1\); "Prompt blocks: " + \([regex]::Matches\($c,'\(?m\)^### Prompt '\)\).Count; "Docker mentions before 12.7: " + \([regex]::Matches\($c.Substring\(0,$c.IndexOf\('### Prompt 12.7'\)\),'docker-compose\\.yml|Dockerfile'\)\).Count)

PowerShell($c = Get-Content "docs/prompt.md" -Raw; "Unique prompt IDs: " + \(\([regex]::Matches\($c,'\(?m\)^### Prompt \(\\d+\\.\\d+\)'\) | ForEach-Object { $_.Groups[1].Value }\) | Select-Object -Unique\).Count; "--- Docker/compose refs before 12.7 ---"; Select-String -Path "docs/prompt.md" -Pattern 'docker-compose\\.yml|Dockerfile|docker compose' | Where-Object { $_.LineNumber -lt 3100 } | ForEach-Object { "L$\($_.LineNumber\): $\($_.Line.Trim\(\)\)" })
